entries.visitor_need: Reveal a welcome offer while inviting useful monthly notes.
entries.difference: An illustrated product stage beside signup, followed by an offer reveal.
entries.source: Original WConvert pilot; informed by the research plan dated 2026-09-28.
suggested_setup: Store browsing pages; exclude cart and checkout.
Start after 15 seconds; avoid repeating after dismissal.
entries.measure: Email requests accepted; offer use is a separate store metric.

entries.visitor_need: Offer first knowledge of a collection without defaulting to a discount.
entries.difference: A bold typographic ticket with no discount and a compact signup.
entries.source: Original WConvert pilot; informed by the research plan dated 2026-09-28.
suggested_setup: Collection and launch pages before the release.
Start after 15 seconds; end the campaign when the launch closes.

entries.visitor_need: Save email first and let visitors choose whether to add SMS.
entries.difference: Email is saved independently before an optional second-channel request.
entries.source: Original WConvert pilot; informed by the research plan dated 2026-09-28.
suggested_setup: Relevant store pages with a real announcement programme.
Start after 15 seconds; keep SMS optional.
entries.measure: Email acceptance and optional SMS acceptance separately.

entries.visitor_need: Answer a shipping question without interrupting browsing.
entries.difference: A compact utility bar answers a delivery question without asking for contact details.
entries.source: Original WConvert pilot; informed by the research plan dated 2026-09-28.
suggested_setup: Store browsing pages where delivery information helps.
Show on page load; keep it easy to dismiss.
entries.measure: Clicks to the shop; sales are a separate metric.

entries.visitor_need: Make a focused collection introduction with a single shopping link.
entries.difference: A large editorial announcement focused on one collection link.
entries.source: Original WConvert pilot; informed by the research plan dated 2026-09-28.
suggested_setup: A relevant landing page for a time-limited collection.
Use sparingly; review the schedule and exclude checkout.

entries.visitor_need: Ask only relevant questions, then show a matching selection.
entries.difference: A branching question journey skips irrelevant questions and gives a result before asking for contact details.
entries.source: Original WConvert pilot; informed by the research plan dated 2026-09-28.
suggested_setup: A guide or category page where product choice is difficult.
Invite visitors where recommendations are useful; test every branch.
entries.measure: Result views and product clicks; not sales.

entries.visitor_need: Give the business enough context to start a useful reply.
entries.difference: An inline service docket captures the type of work alongside a reply address.
entries.source: Original WConvert pilot; informed by the research plan dated 2026-09-28.
suggested_setup: Embed below service details or a work example.
Visible in the page; no interruption.
entries.measure: Accepted enquiries; a quote is provided separately.

entries.visitor_need: Make a low-friction first contact after viewing a portfolio.
entries.difference: An image-led portrait invitation asks for the minimum needed to start a conversation.
entries.source: Original WConvert pilot; informed by the research plan dated 2026-09-28.
suggested_setup: Portrait portfolio and session-information pages.
Start after 15 seconds of viewing; avoid repeated interruptions.

entries.visitor_need: Offer a small invitation while a visitor explores your services.
entries.difference: A small corner invitation leaves the service page visible during the request.
entries.source: Original WConvert pilot; informed by the research plan dated 2026-09-28.
suggested_setup: Design service and project-detail pages.
Start after 15 seconds; keep dismissal clear.
entries.measure: Consultation requests; appointments are confirmed separately.

entries.visitor_need: Help visitors prepare before they ask for a quote.
entries.difference: A numbered notebook cover makes a single planning resource tangible.
entries.source: Original WConvert pilot; informed by the research plan dated 2026-09-28.
suggested_setup: Renovation articles and planning service pages.
Start after 15 seconds; connect the actual checklist delivery.
entries.measure: Accepted resource requests; delivery must be tested separately.

entries.visitor_need: Invite readers who have finished an article to return next week.
entries.difference: An inline editorial composition continues the reading experience at the end of an article.
entries.source: Original WConvert pilot; informed by the research plan dated 2026-09-28.
suggested_setup: Embed after an article or beside a reading-list introduction.
Visible in the page; set an honest weekly expectation.
entries.measure: Accepted newsletter requests; monitor downstream subscriptions.

entries.visitor_need: Let visitors receive a useful recommendation without requiring signup.
entries.difference: An ungated recommendation appears before an optional email request.
entries.source: Original WConvert pilot; informed by the research plan dated 2026-09-28.
suggested_setup: Resource hubs and related articles.
Let the visitor see the result even if they skip email.
entries.measure: Result views and optional email requests separately.
